user.title: Connect to your UPS card
user.description: Sign in with the card's web admin account. Complete initial card setup first. Home Assistant's MQTT integration must already be configured.

broker.title: Configure MQTT automatically
broker.description: This enables MQTT and Home Assistant discovery on {host}, after checking its memory budget. The card restarts; UPS output stays on. The suggested broker is your existing Home Assistant broker. MQTT has no TLS: broker credentials are sent in plaintext and stored in card flash. Use existing credentials or enter a dedicated account with the checkbox off. Card admin credentials are discarded after setup. Entities are supplied by the standard MQTT integration.

data.address: Broker IPv4 address reachable from the card
data.use_existing_credentials: Use Home Assistant's existing broker credentials
data.username: Dedicated broker username (up to 24 ASCII bytes)
data.password: Dedicated broker password (up to 32 ASCII bytes)
data.confirm_plaintext: Allow transferring and storing broker credentials on this card

error.invalid_auth: The card rejected the admin credentials.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the card or resolve the broker. Check the address and network.
error.unsupported_firmware: Update the card to firmware with MQTT resource admission and device identification, and complete its initial setup.
error.resources: The card cannot fit MQTT with its current protocols. Disable an optional protocol in the card configuration and retry.
error.wrong_device: The address now belongs to a different card. Discover or add it again.
error.config_changed: Card configuration changed or the card is restarting. Wait for it to return, then retry.
error.save_uncertain: The save result is uncertain. Do not repeat blindly: wait for the card to restart and check its configuration. Retrying this form reads the current revision before saving.
error.mqtt_required: Set up Home Assistant's MQTT integration first.
error.mqtt_incompatible: This card requires plain TCP MQTT with the default homeassistant discovery prefix. Your current MQTT integration uses incompatible settings.
error.broker_config: Check the broker IPv4 address, port and credentials. Username must be at most 24 ASCII bytes and password at most 32; a password requires a username. Use a dedicated account if existing credentials exceed these bounds.
error.confirm_required: Confirm the credential transfer before applying this configuration.
